title: Now Be Cyber Smart
summary: The Rotary Club of Bombay Northwest – Malad organised a Cyber Smart Awareness Session for 100 students from JDT English Medium School.
description: The Rotary Club of Bombay Northwest – Malad organised a Cyber Smart Awareness Session for 100 students from JDT English Medium School. The session focused on online safety, cyber threats, fraud prevention, and responsible digital practices, empowering students to stay alert, informed, and safe in the digital world.
